name: Ethiopia (Transitional Government, 1991–1996)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of green, yellow and red.
history: After the fall of the Derg in May 1991 the Transitional Government of Ethiopia used the plain green, yellow and red tricolour, long the civil flag of the country, without any emblem. The present flag with the blue disc and star was adopted on 31 October 1996 by the Federal Democratic Republic.
